visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable views against individually viewed local Qualla exterior originals and both pages of the official Getty visitor plan. Museum ranges enclose an open inner court; west entrance has two open gallery levels, and south balcony faces the long outer pool. Final review removed an incorrect solid south-colonnade back wall and added the shallow northern museum projection. Attached south terrace has through-open brick arches. Final pool correction gives the water an open basin rim, eliminating the overlapping stone cap and visible depth flicker.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven current shared-material views including full front/back and map overlay. Cream stucco, pale limestone, red tile and brick use four shared metric surfaces, with local glass and pool water. Flat-ground fixtures obscure the below-datum terrace supports; independent terrain views expose their hillside setting.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen current lighting, quality and forced-detail views. Skyline retains the two-court layout, long pool, open colonnades and south supporting arcade. District restores window and painted-wall rhythms; street adds columns, pilasters, window surrounds and rails; closeup adds finer capitals, fluting, roof ribs, coffers and balusters. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures; no physical-device performance measurement claimed.

geographicReview.notes: Anchor [-118.56505,34.04509], heading -0.6 radians: east-southeast +X, south-southwest +Z along the outer peristyle. Mapped museum envelope, inner-court hole, outer U, west entrance and south viewing terrace align with source geometry. Independent unmodified USGS CA_LosAngeles_B23 raster 114605 retained; datum 53.8476 m NAVD88 at west approach [-44,-49]. Main and court floors Y=1, upper galleries Y=6.3. East retaining base and south arcade descend into the measured slope; no ground flattening or geometry fitting. Source ground under structures is interpolated. Footprint replacement disabled.

fidelityReview.scope: Main museum villa, inner/outer peristyles, pools, west entrance gallery and attached south terrace. Separate modern campus buildings excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Two primary and four supplemental local Qualla images, both pages of the official Getty 2023 visitor plan, Getty garden descriptions and aerial roof context establish individual massing. Hidden joins, exact gallery depths and heights remain estimates. Column ornament, wall painting, roof tile and baluster profiles are simplified; no artworks, interiors, vegetation, visitors or photo pixels copied.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels visually inspected and within budgets. Exact triangle and byte counts are recorded in levels; error values are authoring budgets, not measured deviations.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; independent terrain PNG encoding error recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run claimed.
